Improves statistical reporting for non-invasive BCI benchmark comparisons.

items.title_zh: MOABB v1.7.1 发布

bullets_zh: NeuroTechX于2026年8月31日发布MOABB v1.7.1。
当NEMAR因代理或HTTP故障不可达时，它仍可使用本地缓存的上游数据集数据。

bullets_en: NeuroTechX released MOABB v1.7.1 on 2026-08-31.
It keeps locally cached upstream dataset data usable when NEMAR is unreachable through proxy or HTTP failures.
The release catches leaked httpx.TransportError exceptions at NEMAR download boundaries and preserves auto provider fallback.

items.brief_en: MOABB v1.7.1 improves offline cached dataset availability when NEMAR is unreachable.
items.raw_excerpt: MOABB 1.7.1 keeps locally cached upstream dataset data usable when NEMAR is unreachable through a proxy or another HTTP transport failure. - Catch leaked `httpx.TransportError` exceptions at all NEMAR download boundaries. - Preserve the default `auto` provider fallback to the dataset's own downloader. See [PR #1171](https://github.com/NeuroTechX/moabb/pull/1171).
